claim: Alia Bhatt is only an actress.

top_3_decisive_points.point: Source S1 (Trust 1.0) lists multiple verified roles for Alia Bhatt beyond acting – film producer, founder of a production company and a clothing brand, singer, and philanthropist – directly contradicting the absolute claim that she is "only" an actress.

The word "only" conveys exclusivity. Because the source documents concrete activities in other domains, the statement "Alia Bhatt is only an actress" is factually inaccurate and misleading, regardless of her primary profession.

The defender’s argument hinges on a semantic narrowing of "only" to mean "main profession" and cites the phrase "predominantly works as an actress" from S1, but this does not negate the existence of other verified occupations, making the defence insufficient to rescue the claim.

verdict.final_reasoning: The high‑trust source S1 confirms that Alia Bhatt is indeed a prominent actress, but it also unequivocally records her extensive activities as a film producer, entrepreneur, singer, and philanthropist. The original statement "Alia Bhatt is only an actress" asserts exclusivity, which is contradicted by these facts. The defender’s reliance on the word "predominantly" does not override the factual inaccuracy introduced by the absolute term "only". Consequently, the claim is misleading: it contains a grain of truth (her acting career) but omits significant, well‑documented aspects of her professional life. According to the scoring rubric, this places the news item at the "Misleading/Mostly False" level, corresponding to a truth_score of 0.25.

--- Source: Alia Bhatt ---
Alia Bhatt (; born 15 March 1993) is a British actress of Indian descent who predominantly works in Hindi films. Known for her portrayals of women in challenging circumstances, she has received several accolades, including a National Film Award and seven Filmfare Awards. She is one of India's highest-paid actresses. Time awarded her with the Time100 Impact Award in 2022 and named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2024.
Born into the Bhatt family, she is a daughter of filmmaker Mahesh Bhatt and actress Soni Razdan. After making her acting debut as a child in the 1999 thriller film Sangharsh, she played her first leading role in Karan Johar's teen film Student of the Year (2012). She won the Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actress for playing a kidnapping victim in the road drama Highway (2014) and went on to establish herself with starring roles in several romantic films produced by Johar's studio Dharma Productions.
Bhatt won Filmfare Awards for Best Actress for playing a victim of drug abuse in the crime drama Udta Punjab (2016), an undercover spy in the thriller Raazi (2018), a possessive girlfriend in the musical drama Gully Boy (2019), and the title role of a prostitute in the biopic Gangubai Kathiawadi (2022). The last of these also earned her the National Film Award for Best Actress. She expanded to film production with the black comedy Darlings (2022) and had her biggest commercial success in the fantasy film Brahmāstra: Part One – Shiva (2022) and the romantic comedy Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani (2023). The last of these earned her a fifth Best Actress award at Filmfare, followed by a record-setting sixth for her performance in the action thriller Jigra (2024), which she also co-produced.
In addition to acting, Bhatt supports various charities and is an investor and prominent brand endorser. She founded an ecological initiative, CoExist, in 2017, a production company, Eternal Sunshine Productions, in 2019, and a sustainable clothing brand, Ed-a-Mamma, in 2022. Bhatt has sung eight of her film songs, including the single "Samjhawan Unplugged" in 2014. She is married to actor Ranbir Kapoor, with whom she has a daughter.

debate_history.challenger_argument: Bằng chứng từ nguồn S1 cho thấy Alia Bhatt thực hiện nhiều vai trò ngoài diễn xuất: cô là nhà sản xuất, nhà sáng lập các dự án kinh doanh, ca sĩ và nhà từ thiện. Do đó khẳng định cô "chỉ là một actress" là hoàn toàn sai lệch và thiếu căn cứ.

defender_claims.text: [R1] Bản tin gốc "Alia Bhatt is only an actress" vẫn đúng vì trong ngữ cảnh này "only" chỉ tới nghề nghiệp chính và nhận dạng công chúng của cô – diễn viên.  Nguồn S1 mô tả rõ ràng: “Alia Bhatt … is a British actress of Indian descent who predominantly works in Hindi films.” Câu này khẳng định rằng công việc chính và phần lớn thời gian của cô là diễn xuất.  Các hoạt động phụ như thành lập công ty sản xuất, sáng lập dự án sinh thái, làm nhà đầu tư, ca sĩ hay nhà từ thiện được đề cập chỉ như “In addition to acting…” – tức là chúng là bổ trợ, không thay đổi thực tế rằng nghề nghiệp chủ đạo của cô là diễn viên.  Vì vậy việc nhấn mạnh rằng cô “cũng làm những việc khác” không phủ nhận được tính đúng của câu gốc; câu gốc chỉ nói về vai trò chính của Alia Bhatt, và bằng chứng từ S1 chứng minh rằng vai trò chính ấy là diễn viên.
